title: Sky Critters
description: Fly a drone over a toy-like 3D city and shoot down waves of flying critters before they reach your base tower. Earn coins to upgrade your gear, alone or in multiplayer.
how_to_play: WASD to fly, mouse to look, Space and Shift to go up and down, and click to shoot. Keys 1-4 switch weapons. M mutes sounds and N mutes music.
